data.one_liner: An HTTP Cookies implementation for the client to get, set and remove cookies.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client-side HTTP cookies implementation allowing developers to get, set, and remove cookies easily. It includes null safety support and is simple to use.
use_when: You need to manage HTTP cookies on the client side
You want a simple and well-tested cookie implementation
avoid_when: You require a full networking client with built-in cookie management like Dio
weaknesses: Very limited scope focusing only on cookie management

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: A comprehensive HTTP client package that may handle your overall networking needs.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: A powerful HTTP client for Dart, which includes interceptors and cookie management support.
